method: Exact full .08 finite opaque extrusion retained. A unit horizontal normal fan and height-defined stone plane/shoulder field replace the radial upward cap lobe. Normalized upper response follows gently tilted course planes w=z+.10y; lower cap illumination no longer gains an artificial y0 upward-normal peak. Controlled course/roof turns describe shoulders. Coherent04 course material retained. Interior mesh normals use stronger face-plane weighting and no pervasive analytic mix; spatial collar transition remains smooth. Normalize after interpolation, after blend, after proper object NORMAL transform. Actual graph parameters and independent linked-graph evaluation retained. New field has zero longitudinal x derivative, matching y/z derivatives and actual radiance under all4. No old field values treated as locks.

shaderFormula.normal: normalize((cos(phi),sin(phi),q)); normalized up response q/sqrt(1+q*q); stone course planes w=z+.10y, no radial y0 lobe
shaderFormula.interiorBlend: POINT smooth(.26,.42,abs(x)); actual CORNER mesh normal normalize(.30*polygonNormal+.70*vertexNormal); complete full .08 collar actual weights1
shaderFormula.crownMaterial: native CORNER roof albedo multiplied .70; upper-front native stone tints1.50/1.34
